newsitem.title: INDIA: India 12.59 pct bond dips sharply on RBI sale news.
newsitem.headline: India 12.59 pct bond dips sharply on RBI sale news.

text.p: The 12.59 percent government stock 2004 fell sharply on Tuesday following the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)'s announcement it would sell this stock on tap from June 25, dealers said.
"The stock fell to 100.25 rupees from 101.40 yesterday," a bank dealer said.
Dealers said the market was confused about RBI's move.
"Are they selling at par or at a premium?" asked a dealer.
"Why should they sell at par when the stock is quoted at a premium in the secondary market?" he asked.
RBI officials were not immediately available for comment.
